g.text: Claim: outbound containment of the hosted-agent tools is enforced by the Foundry PLATFORM; the AKS side is a stand-in caller and is NOT governed
2. AKS cluster, namespace agent-boundary-lab (NOT governed by the Foundry policy)
Secret a2a-facade-config: ONE shared bearer token (weak by design).
Entra Agent ID sidecar = issue #4, PROPOSED, not started.
verifier are NOT governed by the
Images pulled from ACR by kubelet identity (AcrPull). Local model GGUF baked into the image.
Microsoft-managed VNet (V2, AllowInternetOutbound): where the agent containers run
Account-level RAI egress policies (preview ARM API) + managed-network outbound rule
NOT part of the RAI policy)
- The run-... id is in the URL PATH (/policy/run-..., /ingest/run-...), so it appears in the platform row (Data, Properties.path)
and in the receipt. This is the join that works.
- OperationId does NOT join (0 of 129+ egress rows share an app OperationId).
- The ui-... and harness ids are NOT linked to run-... by any row.
- Proof = platform Deny/Enforced row AND no receipt (read >= 180 s later) next to the Allow row + receipt for the permitted call.
- App spans for enforced runs do NOT reach App Insights; link to a missing app span is NOT VERIFIED.
AKS stand-in caller: NOT governed by policy
FLOWS (verified = observed in telemetry-map / compatibility, otherwise labelled)
F1 Browser -> kubectl port-forward (8082 harness / 8081 demo-ui) -> pod. Shared bearer token. VERIFIED.
F2 harness -> local-model, OpenAI-compatible /v1 tool calling (in-cluster, no real credential). VERIFIED, n=1 chat turn (0.14).
F3 harness tool -> A2A SendMessage (JSON-RPC, bearer, A2A-Version 1.0) -> facade audit / enforced. VERIFIED (0.13, 0.14).
F4 facade -> Foundry Responses (store=False, get_openai_client(agent_name=...), Entra token of the demo-ui workload identity,
Foundry Agent Consumer role) -> hosted agent. Calls SUCCEED (observed). Network path (AKS -> private endpoint) is ASSUMED from
'data plane reachable only from inside the VNet'; the managed-VNet vs egress-policy layering is an open doc gap (compat. D).
F5 hosted agent get_servicing_policy -> policy-api: egress decision Allow + receipt (both modes). VERIFIED.
F6 send_to_external_processor -> test-receiver. Audit: AuditWouldDeny row + request reaches + receipt. Enforced: Deny/DefaultDeny
row (Enforced, NoMatchingAllowRule), NO receipt. VERIFIED, B/C PASS (small n).
F7 Platform egress decision rows (AppDependencies, NetworkEgressDecision) -> App Insights; written by the platform, not our code. VERIFIED.
F8 policy-api / test-receiver stdout receipts -> Log Analytics ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL. VERIFIED.
F9 Agent telemetry export to App Insights: enforced run shows Deny/DefaultDeny rows (observed); link to missing app spans NOT VERIFIED.
F10 verify_demo.py B/C, kql-queries.md and the workbook (PROPOSED, not applied) read evidence by run-... id. verify: VERIFIED.
F11 task build:* -> ACR; ACR -> AKS image pull; ACR -> hosted-agent image (one digest); agent-harness init container publishes both versions.
